title: First it is warm then it gets cold
html_source:
Joyce was the most systematic of writers and thinkers: his images are typically arranged among their symmetrical opposites.

The word cold is reflected often through the course of this chapter, such as when Stephen falls in the bog and when he falls ill and feels an icy chill.
